title: REGRESSION from #2981: UNWIND + consecutive MATCH now plans a Value Hash Join over a full label scan instead of per-row index seeks
introduced_by: #2981 (82ac492b9); 4205fec13 (its parent) still uses per-row Node By Index Scan
numbers: 300-row batch: 200k readings 7.2 -> 10.9 ms, 1M readings 7.5 -> 54.5 ms (linear in label size); s12 full run: ingest_single 190.7/s p50 0.75 ms -> 2.7/s p50 275 ms, ingest_batch 94/s -> 10.9/s; side effect: chain-guard check fails because writers fall behind retention. Same change makes bulk loads faster (s12 load 215 -> 71 s, s02/s04/s11 about 2x), so this is a cost-model choice (hash join vs index-seek apply), not a revert candidate
status: #3887, fix PR #3889 (open): per-row index seek, repro 56 → 6.5 ms
